title: Compact generation of the quasi-coherent derived category
statement: For every quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme X [def-pc-scheme], the derived category D_QCoh(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] is compactly generated.

proof.text: By the perfect-generation theorem, the smallest strictly full subcategory of D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) containing all perfect complexes and closed under shifts, cones, retracts, and arbitrary set-indexed direct sums is all of D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X).

By lem-pc-perfect-object-compact every perfect complex is compact, and by lem-pc-perfect-complexes-compact-set the perfect complexes have a set of representatives up to isomorphism; choose representatives (E_i)_{i\in I}. Their coproduct E=\bigoplus_i E_i exists in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) by lem-pc-derived-qcoh-direct-sums. To see that E is a generator [def-pc-generators], let K be an object with \operatorname{Hom}(E,K[n])=0 for all n, and let \mathcal A be the strictly full subcategory of objects A with \operatorname{Hom}(A[m],K)=0 for all m\in\mathbf Z. Since \operatorname{Hom}(E,K[n])=\prod_i\operatorname{Hom}(E_i,K[n]) by the universal property of the coproduct, every E_i, hence every perfect complex (each is isomorphic to some E_i), lies in \mathcal A. \mathcal A is closed under shifts (by definition), retracts (Hom of a retract is a retract of Hom), set-indexed direct sums (\operatorname{Hom}(\bigoplus_j A_j[m],K)=\prod_j\operatorname{Hom}(A_j[m],K)), and cones: for a distinguished triangle A\to B\xrightarrow{v} C\xrightarrow{d} A[1] with A,B\in\mathcal A, a map c:C[m]\to K satisfies c\circ v[m]=0 since \operatorname{Hom}(B[m],K)=0, so by lem-weil-pbc-hom-out-of-triangle-exact (ii) it factors through d[m] via a map A[m+1]\to K, which is zero. By Step 1, \mathcal A is all of D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X), so K\in\mathcal A, \operatorname{id}_K=0 and K=0. Hence every nonzero K admits n and a nonzero map E\to K[n]: E is a generator.

proof.text: D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) has arbitrary set-indexed coproducts by lem-pc-derived-qcoh-direct-sums. Applying the definition of compactly generated triangulated category, the set-indexed family (E_i) of compact objects of Step 2, whose coproduct is a generator, makes D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) compactly generated.
